<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="428" height="926" viewBox="0 0 428 926">
  <rect width="428" height="926" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="31" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>

    <g transform="translate(338,18)">
      <rect x="0" y="8" width="18" height="11.33" rx="2.67" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="1.5" y="9.5" width="5" height="8.2" rx="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="21" y1="10" x2="21" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.4"/>
      <circle cx="28" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="40" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="50" y="8.5" width="14" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="57" cy="13" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Back arrow -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="38,78 28,88 38,98" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="88" x2="43" y2="88" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Heading -->
  <text x="24" y="154" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#E4E6EB">Forgot Password ?</text>
  <text x="24" y="192" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Don’t worry! it happens. Please enter your email</text>
  <text x="24" y="216" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">address or mobile number to receive a reset code.</text>

  <!-- Input field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="262" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Email address or mobile number</text>
    <rect x="24" y="274" width="380" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="44" y="304" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">jordan.lee@example.com</text>
    <g transform="translate(362,286)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="15" x2="20" y2="20" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Helper card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="344" width="380" height="118" rx="8" fill="#2A2C30" opacity="0.95"/>
    <rect x="24" y="344" width="380" height="118" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="372" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">Reset options</text>

    <g transform="translate(40,388)">
      <rect x="0" y="4" width="28" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <line x1="7" y1="11" x2="21" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="7" y1="17" x2="21" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="14" y1="8" x2="14" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="40" y="16" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">We can send a verification link to your inbox</text>
      <text x="40" y="34" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">or a 6-digit code by SMS.</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Tips list -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="496" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">Before you continue</text>

    <g transform="translate(24,510)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="3" fill="#34EAB9"/>
      <text x="18" y="12" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Use the email or phone number linked to your account.</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(24,536)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="3" fill="#FFD789"/>
      <text x="18" y="12" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Check your spam folder if the email doesn’t arrive.</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(24,562)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="3" fill="#FF84B7"/>
      <text x="18" y="12" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">The reset code expires in 10 minutes.</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom action area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="804" width="428" height="122" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <rect x="0" y="804" width="428" height="122" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <g transform="translate(24,823)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="190" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit</text>
    </g>

    <text x="214" y="894" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Remembered your password?</text>
    <text x="214" y="914" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Back to sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="848" width="428" height="78" fill="#1F2227"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="848" x2="428" y2="848" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g transform="translate(34,860)">
      <polygon points="18,6 6,15 30,15" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <rect x="10" y="15" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="18" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Home</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(126,860)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="12" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="24" y1="18" x2="30" y2="24" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(212,860)">
      <rect x="10" y="6" width="16" height="22" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="13" y="9" width="10" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="13" y="13" width="10" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="13" y="17" width="10" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="18" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1877F2">Saved</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(298,860)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="10" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="12" y="17" width="12" height="9" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="18" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Alerts</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(368,860)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="12" r="7" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="12" r="3" fill="#1F2227"/>
      <text x="18" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
